description: This Java source file defines AttractionsGridPagerAdapter, an adapter for a Wear OS app's GridViewPager component. It manages and displays a grid of attraction items, including images, descriptions, and interactive action pages for navigation and opening attractions on a device. The class handles view instantiation, background setting, and user interactions, including fade-in/fade-out effects for UI chrome.

classes.name: AttractionsGridPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for managing attraction pages in a Wear OS GridViewPager, providing image, description, and action views, and handling UI fade effects.

classes.name: AttractionsGridPagerAdapter.DelayedHide
classes.description: Inner class to handle delayed hiding and fading in/out of UI chrome views.

methods.name: AttractionsGridPagerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and attraction data.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the list of attractions to be displayed.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns number of rows, based on the number of attractions.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns fixed column count for grid.

methods.name: instantiateItem
methods.description: Creates and returns a view for a specified row and column, inflating layouts for images, descriptions, and actions.

methods.name: getBackgroundForPage
methods.description: Returns background drawable for a page, typically an attraction's image.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Removes a page view and its associated hide effects.
